raw_printing.name: Existential Dread
raw_printing.rules_html:
[Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
[Repeat] :rb_energy_2: (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
[Stun] an attacking enemy unit. If it's already stunned, return it to its owner's hand instead. (A stunned unit doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

findings: Morbid Return chooses one unit card in its controller’s trash before responses; returning it to hand neither draws nor plays it.

Existential Dread requires an enemy unit with the Attacker designation, rechecked on resolution. Each execution checks the live Stunned state: already Stunned returns to owner; otherwise Stun. Repeat costs two Energy and has independently declared targets.
